main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean 10-bar forward return minus mean 10-bar forward return of all bars of the same coin and window

statistic.name: t of the forecast-weighted mean excess across non-overlapping blocks

main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 confirms (with positive hit-rate difference); excess < 0 with t <= -2 rejects; otherwise or fewer than 30 positive-forecast blocks inconclusive

supporting_check.name: hit rate of positive-forecast bars minus hit rate of all bars (10-bar forward return > 0)

decided_by: The excess over holding is negative with t <= -2: moves after up-crosses underperform holding.
reading: Blocks are the bars at positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window with a full 10-bar forward return inside it; each positive-forecast block's return is taken minus the mean over all grid blocks of its own coin and window, then forecast-weighted and pooled, with t = weighted mean / weighted standard error; the hit-rate shares use the same grid pooled across coins and windows.
